trajectory.content:
I can do this, but I need the tracker and a couple small details before I send anything. To avoid sending the wrong offers, please provide or confirm the following (I’ll use sensible defaults only if you tell me to):

Required from you
- Google Sheets tracker: spreadsheet URL or spreadsheet ID and worksheet name (where offers and approval statuses live).
- Which column indicates full approval (exact column/header text)? (Default I’ll use if you say “use defaults”: "Approval Status" with value "Approved".)
- Which column should I update with the DocuSign status (exact column/header text)? (Default: "DocuSign Status".)
- DocuSign template ID to use for the offer, or confirm that each row contains a Template ID column I should use.
- Which column(s) contain candidate name, candidate email, and any field values to populate the template (exact column headers)? (Defaults: "Candidate Name", "Candidate Email", "Offer Terms" / field names.)

Optional (defaults I will use if you don’t provide)
- Email subject: "Your Offer from [Company]" (I’ll replace [Company] if you provide company name).
- Email body/blurb: brief standard blurb letting candidate know to review and sign.
- Sender name/email: use the default system sender unless you give a specific sender.

Workflow I will run once you provide/confirm above
- Find rows where Approval column == fully approved and DocuSign Status is blank (or shows a status indicating not yet sent).
- For each approved candidate:
  - Create and send a DocuSign envelope from the specified template, populating fields with that row’s terms.
  - Record the DocuSign envelope ID and update the tracker’s DocuSign Status cell per the tracker convention (e.g., "Sent — envelope: <envelope_id>") and add timestamp.
- Return a summary of candidates processed, envelope IDs, and any failures.

If you want me to proceed now, either:
- Paste the spreadsheet URL and the template ID (and any column-header names you prefer), or
- Reply “Use defaults” and confirm I should proceed with assumed column names and template id (I’ll use placeholders and attempt the sends).
